title: Nutmeg Italian Fennel Cacio E Pepe Style Risotto
description: A creamy, indulgent take on the classic Italian dish featuring fennel and nutmeg.
instructions: Heat butter in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add sliced fennel and cook until tender, about 8 minutes.
Add Arborio rice and cook for 1-2 minutes, until lightly toasted.
Add white wine and cook until absorbed, about 2 minutes.
Add 1 cup of hot chicken broth to the rice mixture and cook, stirring constantly, until absorbed.
Repeat the process, adding the broth in 1 cup increments, until the rice is cooked and creamy, about 20 minutes total.
Stir in Romano cheese, Pecorino Romano cheese, and nutmeg.
Season with black pepper to taste.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
